title: Hearty Umami Brazilian Chicken Curry
description: A quick and flavorful Brazilian dish featuring Thai red curry paste, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is egg-free-friendly and can be cooked in a copper mug.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a copper mug over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the mug and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the mug and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk, diced tomatoes, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper to the mug.
Stir the mixture until it is well combined and the curry paste is fully incorporated.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 10 minutes.
Remove the mug from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
